title: Mailroom Schedule: Envelope Charge on Name Amendments, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The name-amendment envelope charge follows how the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate travels and whether any transmission of the filing was sent today.

| Certificate travels by | Any transmission of the filing sent today | Name-amendment envelope charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paper mail | Yes — the name amendment rides with it | 1.25 (enclosure) |
| Paper mail | No | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Electronic transmission | Either | None |

How a certificate travels is its transmission method in the certificate's timetable. Any transmission on the filing's record dated today counts, whatever was sent.

**Hypothetical cases.** A paper-mail certificate with an amendment transmission dated today: 1.25. The same certificate with nothing sent today: 9.85. An electronic certificate: none.
